description: Defaults for the Shop Supplies forms (Add Supply Item, Receive, Issue, Count).

fields.label: Defaults
fields.description: The forms create normal Stock Entries and Stock Reconciliations. Perpetual inventory applies, so receipts, issues and count changes post to accounting.

fields.label: Default Warehouse
fields.description: Pre-selected on every form. Any department warehouse can still be picked.

fields.label: Default Item Group
fields.description: Pre-selected when adding a supply item.

fields.label: Issue Expense Account
fields.description: Optional. Account charged when supplies are issued. Blank uses the item or item group expense account, then the company Stock Adjustment account.

name: Shop Supplies Settings
